name: Sullivan County, TN
findings: Sullivan County has 392 nonprofit organizations. 172 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 138 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sullivan County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Sullivan County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 35% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
